paragraphs: Yaavetz, Rabbi Yehudah HaNasi’s son, entered the Garden of Eden alive: Derekh Eretz Zuta, end of chapter 1. Yalkut, Ezekiel, section 28 (remez 367 in the retrieved edition), has Rabbi Yehudah’s grandson.
